usage: Protocol reference only. Node Comics implements inert TypeScript HTML/JSON parsing through its existing source contracts and caller transport; upstream Kotlin/APK code is not executed or bundled.
scope: Explicitly registered Lagoon Scans, UnderTranslations, Arena Scans, Akaza Scans, Aster Scans, King of Shojo and NekoScans / Neko Manga: public WordPress name search, complete static chapterlist, dedicated work cover, consistent canonical and allc chapter ownership, full-mode ts_reader.run JSON with one image source. Akaza Scans and Aster Scans explicitly use the verified legacy document-ready wrapper without modern access fields, requiring exact agreement between public HTML images and JSON slots despite the stale default-source label. King of Shojo explicitly uses modern access flags with contentmode minimal and exact public HTML/JSON agreement. No source scripts, view-count POSTs, account actions, protected-page unlocks, novels, alternate randomized slugs, DOM-only or base64/obfuscated reader variants are implemented.
